feeds.title: The Yoga Place Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Iyengar yoga, its benefits, our teachers and services offered, etc. The Yoga Place is La Crosse's first yoga studio, offering Iyengar yoga since 1988. Our teachers are known for their depth of knowledge and clear, effective teaching skills.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga Centre
feeds.description: Learn more about Iyengar Yoga, our centers and get the latest news from us. IYCV a not for profit/registered charity. Yoga based on the teachings of BKS Iyengar.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for the latest news and updates from the IY association, community news, teachers and benefits of Iyengar yoga. IY(UK) is the Association for Iyengar yoga teachers and practitioners in the UK and Ireland. We represent over 1200 teachers and thousands of students.

feeds.title: Svejar Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Svenja and I share my joy and inspiration for illustrated yoga sequences on this blog. In 2013 I started the teacher training as an Iyengar Yoga teacher, which I completed in 2016.

feeds.title: Alcove Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Read all about The stories behind Alcove Yoga. A boutique studio of Iyengar Yoga in the heart of Houston Heights.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga Vancouver
feeds.description: Get updates on upcoming workshops and events, information on Iyengar yoga, postures, health and mind benefits and more! Our association, named after yoga master B.K.S. Iyengar, serves Vancouver and surrounding regions in British Columbia. We are a nonprofit organization that encourages the pursuit of transformation through B.K.S. Iyengar's teachings.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga Source Blog
feeds.description: Know more about our classes, latest news, services and more! IYS offers the Iyengar method of yoga, exclusively. Our teachers are rigorously trained and certified.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga Institute South London News
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from IYISL community and find more information about Iyengar yoga. The Iyengar Yoga Institute South London, based in Deptford, offers high quality teaching for a range of abilities and a dedicated, tranquil space for students, teachers and the Iyengar Yoga community to meet.

feeds.title: Yoga Life Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to a Life of wellness. Through this blog I share my thoughts, ideas and experiences with the intention of sharing so we can create a world of peace and in turn, create a network of wisdom. YogaLife was established in 2012 by Lizette Gatehouse, Certified Iyengar Yoga Teacher and Wellness Advocate, to offer people a safe and supportive environment to learn Yoga to find and create balance in their lives.

feeds.title: College Hill Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Explore class updates, news and articles regarding the practice of Iyengar yoga. College Hill Yoga offers a fun and challenging Iyengar Yoga program. Aaron Fleming, the program director, is a certified Iyengar Yoga instructor.

feeds.title: Iyengar Yoga London News
feeds.description: Get Yoga news, events, updates, advice, in-depth articles, inspiration & more: it's all in our regularly updated Iyengar yoga blog. London's original Iyengar yoga centre. We've been welcoming students of all levels since B.K.S. Iyengar first taught here in 1983.

feeds.title: IYASE Blog
feeds.description: THe blog is for Information Dissemination about Iyengar yoga and news in the Iyengar yoga community. Iyengar Yoga Association Southeast US (IYASE), a regional organization of Iyengar Yoga Association of US.

feeds.title: This is Mimi Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Iyengar yoga, Mimi's journey as a certified yoga teacher, updates on classes and workshops and more! Mimi Pajo is a Certified Iyengar Yoga Teacher. She is a devoted student of Gloria Goldberg and Brian Hogencamp.
